players.product: HDD suspensions (Disk Drive Suspension business) for high-capacity HDDs used in AI-related applications and data centers

quarterly_data.quarter: NHK Spring results briefing Q&A: Analyst Financial Results Briefing Q&A Session (05-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on the DDS (Disk Drive Suspension) order environment: cloud service providers (CSPs), the major investors in data centers, have presented HDD manufacturers with nearly finalized order plans for 2027, and continuous, strong demand is expected for 2028 and beyond; HDD manufacturers have indicated strong production plans and the company is formulating its capital investment plans on that basis. DDS volume has grown by around 10 to 15% year-on-year and the company expects this to continue for the next two to three years.
quarterly_data.figure: DDS volume up around 10 to 15% year-on-year; expected to continue for two to three years

quarterly_data.quarter: NHK Spring results briefing Q&A: Analyst Financial Results Briefing Q&A Session (05-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): with strong demand ongoing, the pace of DDS capital expenditures is accelerating, and the company is simultaneously proceeding with line expansions and line conversions to reliably capture demand; asked about pricing, it said it will carefully consult customers regarding the costs incurred and work on raising selling prices by taking advantage of various opportunities. DDS fixed costs rise in the fiscal year ending March 2027 on higher personnel costs from higher volume in Asia plus future investments including human capital and DX.

quarterly_data.quarter: NHK Spring results briefing Q&A: Analyst Financial Results Briefing Q&A Session (05-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): results for the fiscal year ended March 2026 fell short of plan mainly because tariff recoveries were delayed until the fiscal year ending March 2027 and automotive suspension spring production volume decreased in North America. On the Middle East situation, supply of materials such as thinners and paints is tight; procurement is secured through June but the situation from July onward remains uncertain, and suppliers have sent notices of price increases. Some products had been made outside North America because of operational disruptions at North American bases; as those disruptions have subsided, production is returning to North America.

quarterly_data.quarter: NHK Spring results briefing Q&A: Analyst Financial Results Briefing Q&A Session (05-11-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on motor cores: the sales plan for the fiscal year ending March 2027 projects lower revenue than the previous year because of the slowdown in demand for electrification itself and the end of production for existing products; new projects are delayed by pushed-back mass-production launches, which management believes can be recovered. In India there are no finalized projects yet but many inquiries. Management says EV demand is currently stagnating but expects electrification to progress steadily over the medium to long term. Automotive Seating fixed costs also rise on human capital / DX investment, R&D expenses and costs for a new office.
